s.note: Laura the chef catering the big New Year's party
s.how: Top 16 blinis with crème fraîche and smoked salmon. Fill 12 lettuce cups with 300g cooked prawns tossed in mayonnaise and lemon. Serve together on a big platter.

s.note: the street carts around Times Square
s.how: Toss 600g diced chicken thighs in cumin, paprika and oil and thread onto skewers. Grill 10 minutes, turning. Serve with 200g yoghurt mixed with garlic and lemon.

m.note: a big New York night out
m.how: Cook 400g linguine. Fry 500g green prawns in 50g butter with 4 garlic cloves and chilli for 3 minutes. Toss with the pasta, lemon juice and chopped parsley.

w.how: Heat 200ml cream until steaming and pour over 200g chopped dark chocolate. Stir smooth and serve warm with 250g strawberries, banana and marshmallows to dip.

d.how: Chill 750ml sparkling wine and 750ml sparkling grape juice. Pour into flutes just before the countdown. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
